text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu steps up to run in the
Tenno 
Sho (Autumn).
Sirius Symboli was among the 
contenders as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What kind of "flavor" does Sirius
Symboli, 
who has tasted the world, possess? Sparks 
fly as both clash, each hungry to devour 
the other.
